---
title: "Copepod water and carbon content"
author: "Patrick Pata"
date: "2025-03-13"
output: html_document
---

Get the copepod water and carbon content data from the trait database. Filter for Calanus complex.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

trait.lvl1 <- read.csv("C:/Sync/R Workspace/Zooplankton_trait_database/data_input/Trait_dataset_level1/trait_dataset_level1-2023-08-15.csv")


copepods <- trait.lvl1 %>% 
  filter(majorgroup == "Calanoid") %>% 
  filter(traitName %in% c("carbonPDW","carbonPWW","dryWeightPWW",
                          "lipidPDW")) %>%  #"lipidPWW"
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) 
```


Plot dat
```{r}
ggplot(copepods %>% 
         filter(genus %in% c("Calanus", "Neocalanus")), 
       aes(x = scientificName, y = traitValue)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(shape = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  facet_wrap(~traitName, ncol = 2, scales = "free")

ggsave("calanus_carbon_water_content.png")

ggplot(copepods %>% 
         filter(traitName %in% c("carbonPDW","dryWeightPWW")),
       aes(x = genus, y = traitValue)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(shape = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  facet_wrap(~traitName, ncol = 2, scales = "free")
  

ggsave("copepod_genus_carbon_content.png")

```

# Size and carbon
```{r}
trait.lvl1.all <- read.csv("C:/Sync/R Workspace/Zooplankton_trait_database/data_input/Trait_dataset_level1/trait_dataset_level1_excluded-2023-08-15.csv") %>% 
  bind_rows(trait.lvl1)

# Save trait data all subset for calanoid copepods
calanoid.level1.traitdata <- trait.lvl1.all %>% 
  filter(majorgroup == "Calanoid")
# save(calanoid.level1.traitdata, 
#      file = "data/calanoid_trait_data.RData")


calanusize <- trait.lvl1.all %>% 
  filter(genus %in% c("Calanus")) %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% c("Calanus finmarchicus",
                               "Calanus glacialis",
                               "Calanus hyperboreus")) %>% 
  filter(traitName %in% c("bodyLength")) %>%  
  mutate(sizeType = if_else(is.na(sizeType), "not given", sizeType)) %>% 
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) %>% 
  mutate(lifeStage = factor(lifeStage,
                            levels = c("C1","C2","C3","C4","C5",
                                       "adult","female","male"))) %>% 
  mutate(sizeType = factor(sizeType,
                           levels = c("prosome length", "total length",
                                      "body length","not given")))

ggplot(calanusize,
       aes(y = traitValue, x = scientificName,
           color = lifeStage, shape = sizeType)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21:24)) # c(18,15,16,17)


ggsave("figures/traitdatabase_size_info.png",
       height = 6, width = 7, units = "in", bg = "white")

```
